content:
The shaded cells are the four off-diagonal cells plus the center.

The diagonal with sum \(7\) must be \(1+2+4\), so the center is one of \(1,2,4\).  
The other diagonal sums to \(21\), so the other two entries on it sum to \(21-c\), where \(c\) is the center. Since the largest possible sum of two distinct entries is \(9+8=17\), we need \(c=4\).

Thus the four corner cells are \(1,2,8,9\), whose sum is \(20\).  
Total sum \(1+\cdots+9=45\), so the five shaded cells sum to
\[
45-20=25.
\]

\[
\boxed{25}
\]
